Hi Emily —

Appreciate the concise brief and the attachment — helpful. High level answers up front, then a short MAP below. Rishi and Lauren are looped in for technical sizing and procurement support items.

Proposed SLO bands (99th / median) — applied per-request, measured at the API gateway under steady-state traffic:
- 64 tokens: 99p <= 70 ms, median <= 22 ms
- 256 tokens: 99p <= 180 ms, median <= 65 ms
- 512 tokens: 99p <= 360 ms, median <= 140 ms

Notes: these numbers are for the model/quantization we showcased. If you switch to a larger model or reduce quantization, numbers will rise. We recommend adding a 10–15% buffer in your internal SLA to account for tail variance during big bursts.

Throughput per reserved GPU (sustained, single-model serving):
- Baseline (1x standard GPU pool): ~120–180 RPS for 64-token dominant traffic
- Mixed distribution (your attached profile): expect ~40–60 RPS sustained for 512-token heavy workloads

Concurrency guidance (recommended Shard/Instance strategy):
- 100 concurrent users: 1 small shard (keep KV cache warm)
- 400 concurrent users: 2–3 medium shards with active prefix caching
- 1,200 concurrent users: reserved capacity with autoscale policy and a hot fallback pool

Streaming: Redwood streams token-by-token with configurable chunk windows. For lower perceived latency we suggest chunk-size=8 tokens for chat-style UX; chunk-size=16 for longer generative responses. Streaming adds ~2–12 ms per chunk for send overhead.

Attached: proposed_slo_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet with per-token-band math and cost tradeoffs).

Mutual Action Plan (high level):
- May 28 (today) — Redwood shares SLO bands & ops checklist (this email) — owner: Soojin
- May 31 — POC schedule and POC credential handoff — owner: Lauren
- Jun 7 — POC run (48–72 hours steady-state) — owner: Veridian (Emily) + Redwood ops on-call
- Jun 14 — POC results & decision recommendation (pass/fail criteria: meet 99p targets under 48-hour run) — owner: Joint

Can you confirm procurement meeting time on Tuesday? If Tuesday is tight, we can push the POC kickoff to next week but would prefer the earlier cadence.

Best,
Soojin Lee
